title: Sync tax report Excel export with daftar upah calculations
description: Ensure taxReportExcelService.ts uses the same calculation logic as daftarUpahExcelService.ts for upah_kotor. Check that: 1) COL_UPAH_KOTOR uses emp.upah_kotor directly from DataExtractor, 2) COL_BRUTO uses emp.penghasilan_bruto from DataExtractor, 3) All tunjangan components are properly mapped. The tax export should trust the DataExtractor values rather than reconstructing them.

files.change: Lines 577-592: Verify COL_UPAH_KOTOR uses emp.upah_kotor, COL_BRUTO uses emp.penghasilan_bruto. Check that all tunjangan fields (beras, jabatan, masa_kerja, lembur) are properly mapped from emp.* fields.
Verify MonthlyTaxRow mapping (lines 858-918) correctly sets upah_kotor and penghasilan_bruto from DataExtractor values.

criteria: Tax Excel export uses emp.upah_kotor directly (not recalculated)
Tax Excel export uses emp.penghasilan_bruto directly (not recalculated)
Tax export matches daftar upah display values
